subject: Microglial UPRmt drives brain senescence via SAM depletion
script: From Agewell Brief: Microglial UPRmt drives brain senescence via SAM depletion. Mitochondrial stress in human microglia rewires metabolism, disrupts neuronal communication, and promotes senescence. Mitochondrial proteotoxic stress depletes S-adenosylmethionine and remodels lipids in microglia. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
